sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know about the best offline note taking app for Android.

faqs.question: What makes Arkaleo the best offline note taking app?
faqs.answer: Arkaleo keeps 100% of your data on your physical hardware storage with zero cloud dependencies or network requirements. Enjoy instant launch speeds, zero latency, and complete control over your private thoughts.

faqs.question: How does Arkaleo protect note privacy & security?
faqs.answer: Arkaleo features a built-in Digital Security Vault equipped with end-to-end local encryption. Your notes, sketches, image attachments, and backups are strictly unreadable to third parties and tracking scripts.

faqs.question: Does Arkaleo support Markdown and digital canvas handwriting?
faqs.answer: Yes! Arkaleo offers a full Markdown writing editor alongside an integrated stylus canvas for hand-written notes, sketching, and visual diagrams.
